title: Xavio Storefront
description: Search the public Xavio catalog and create firm checkout quotes.
summary: Search the public Xavio catalog and create firm checkout quotes.
offersHint: Search the public Xavio catalog and create firm checkout quotes. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://xavio.in/api/mcp/storefront

toolsPreview.name: search_shop_catalog
toolsPreview.description: Search the public Xavio catalog. Returns in-stock products with price, availability, URL, and merchant.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one product by its Xavio product id.

toolsPreview.name: create_quote
toolsPreview.description: Create a firm 5-minute checkout quote for a set of items. Returns quote_id (pass it to /api/ucp/authorize with a signed agent mandate to complete checkout).

toolsPreview.name: search_shop_knowledge
toolsPreview.description: Semantic + keyword search over Xavio's commerce knowledge: a merchant's product details, policies and FAQs (when `host` is given) plus platform buying guides. Use this to answer questions like sizing, materials, returns, or shipping before recommending a product.
